summary.text: Michael Amos is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 27, listed with Wayne County. His legislative page lists committee assignments on Health and Human Resources, Health Care Regulation and Public Health.

paragraphs.text: Amos' page gives his birth date as February 15, 1993, and his birthplace as Huntington, West Virginia.

It lists Spring Valley High School (2011), a B.S. from Marshall University (2014), an M.D. from the Marshall University Joan C. Edwards School of Medicine (2019), and family medicine training through the Marshall University Department of Family and Community Health (2022).
It lists his occupation as physician.

His affiliations include First Baptist Church of Kenova, the American Academy of Family Physicians, the American Medical Association, the American Board of Family Medicine, the American Board of Obesity Medicine, the National Rifle Association (endowment life member) and the Ceredo-Kenova Area Business Association.
